## What this changes



## Privacy check — required

This repository is public, permanent, and indexed. Contributions carry
information about **technology and providers**, never personal health
information.

Confirm before submitting:

- [ ] Contains no test results, values, findings, diagnoses, conditions,
      symptoms, or medications from a real record
- [ ] Contains no appointment dates, dates of service, or anything that pins to
      a specific person
- [ ] Contains no screenshots, exported files, or tool output produced from real
      medical data
- [ ] Contains no patient or clinician names
- [ ] Any example data is invented, not real
- [ ] The above holds for my commit messages too, not just the diff

If you cannot check every box, do not submit. Rewrite the contribution to
describe the mechanism instead. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

## If this changes skill/SKILL.md

- [ ] Any new claim is structural or cited, not generalized from one person's
      experience
- [ ] Does not weaken the logistics-not-advice boundary or the escalation floor
